description: This file implements the EcuM (ECU Manager) module for an AUTOSAR-based automotive system, including initialization, wakeup management, shutdown procedures, and communication with other modules.

methods.name: EcuM_Init
methods.description: Initializes the ECU Manager, sets up hardware, determines configuration, and starts the OS.

methods.name: EcuM_StartupTwo
methods.description: Performs second stage startup procedures, including driver initialization and RTE startup.

methods.name: EcuM_Shutdown
methods.description: Handles system shutdown, either switching off or resetting the microcontroller.

methods.name: EcuM_GetState
methods.description: Retrieves the current state of the ECU Manager.

methods.name: EcuM_SelectApplicationMode
methods.description: Sets the application mode.

methods.name: EcuM_GetApplicationMode
methods.description: Retrieves the current application mode.

methods.name: EcuM_SelectBootTarget
methods.description: Selects the boot target (not implemented).

methods.name: EcuM_GetBootTarget
methods.description: Retrieves the current boot target (not implemented).

methods.name: EcuM_SelectShutdownTarget
methods.description: Sets the shutdown target and sleep mode.

methods.name: EcuM_GetShutdownTarget
methods.description: Gets the current shutdown target and sleep mode.

methods.name: EcuM_RequestRUN
methods.description: Requests the system to enter run mode for a specific user.

methods.name: EcuM_ReleaseRUN
methods.description: Releases a run mode request for a user.

methods.name: EcuM_KillAllRUNRequests
methods.description: Kills all run requests and initiates shutdown.

methods.name: EcuM_SetWakeupEvent
methods.description: Sets a wakeup event source.

methods.name: EcuM_GetPendingWakeupEvents
methods.description: Returns pending wakeup events.

methods.name: EcuM_GetValidatedWakeupEvents
methods.description: Returns validated wakeup events.

methods.name: EcuM_ValidateWakeupEvent
methods.description: Validates a wakeup event source.

methods.name: EcuM_ClearWakeupEvent
methods.description: Clears wakeup event status.

methods.name: EcuM_RequestPOST_RUN
methods.description: Requests post-run mode for a user.

methods.name: EcuM_ReleasePOST_RUN
methods.description: Releases post-run mode for a user.
